facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.load_scannet_sensor_data: load a Scannet .sens file and parse all RGBD frames with camera intrinsics and extrinsics

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.make2d_array: convert an array of arrays into a 2D numpy array using the make2d helper function
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.parse_ply_header: parse a PLY file header from a stream using PlyData._parse_header to inspect format and elements
